versions.changelog:
Initial release of work-productivity-agent-browser-workflow-helper.

- Provides targeted support for users needing Agent Browser-style workflows, including bug fixes, hardening, and reliability improvements.
- Delivers concise work plans, checklists, automation templates, and implementation support for work-productivity, browser, and headless automation tasks.
- Designed for practical, local-hardware-friendly solutions (e.g., scripts and checklists over cloud-only methods).
- Includes validation steps to ensure outputs directly meet user needs, with clear assumptions and next steps.
